verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop app for working with a coding agent on your own projects through per-chat natural-language sessions, which plausibly covers asking it to troubleshoot code. The evidence never explicitly mentions debugging, error diagnosis or troubleshooting workflows, so only the general natural-language agent interaction is documented. missing for 10: explicit debugging/troubleshooting documentation, examples of diagnosing errors or logs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
